title: AgentPackReference
description: Which Agent Pack version is in play, pinned to an immutable content hash. Trust attaches to a version, never to a name - the same rule the skill registry enforces. lifecycle_state is a Literal PROMOTED because a reference to anything else has no business existing in product traffic.

version_hash.description: sha256 of manifest + prose, truncated to 16 hex chars, recomputed on every load. A mismatch is refused, never warned about.

kind.description: What role this pack plays in a composition. Deliberately not a provider or a tool.

lifecycle_state.description: The only state product traffic may load. Candidates and evaluated-but-unapproved versions cannot be referenced here at all.
